# Impacgo Solutions

> Impacgo Solutions Private Limited is a software and consulting company headquartered in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India (founded 2020). It implements Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and the Microsoft Power Platform, builds its own ERP suite (Impacgo ERP, including Impacgo HRMS), and develops custom web, mobile and AI automation solutions for clients across India and for global enterprises, with India compliance (GST, e-invoicing) built in.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Impacgo Solutions Private Limited
- Founded: 2020, by Venkata Srikar Tantravahi (Founder & CEO)
- Headquarters: No 9-29-19, Gupta Villa, Third Floor, Balaji Nagar, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 530003, India
- Contact: info@impacgo.com, +91 99664 77499, https://www.impacgo.com/contact
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/impacgo-solutions-private-limited/

## Impacgo ERP Suite (our own ERP software)

One connected platform. HRMS, Finance, Chain, Make and Retail are available today; book a free demo at https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/demo.

- [Impacgo ERP overview](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite)
- [Impacgo HRMS: HRMS and payroll software](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/hrms): human resource management: employee records, attendance and shifts, leave, payroll and payslips, recruitment and onboarding, self-service
- [Impacgo Finance: accounting software with GST](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/finance-accounting): general ledger, payables, receivables, bank, GST and tax workflows
- [Impacgo Chain: supply chain and inventory management software](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/supply-chain): supply chain: procurement, sales orders, inventory, warehouses, batch/serial tracking
- [Impacgo Make: manufacturing ERP software](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/manufacturing): manufacturing software: bills of materials, work orders, routings, job cards, production costing
- [Impacgo Plan: MRP and production planning software](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/mrp-planning): demand and supply planning, MRP, scheduling, capacity
- [Impacgo Retail: retail POS and billing software](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/retail-pos): retail ERP and POS: billing, pricing, multi-store operations, payments, synced to inventory and accounts
- [Impacgo Project: project management software](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/project-management): projects, tasks, Kanban/Gantt planning, budgets, timesheets
- [Book a free Impacgo ERP demo](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/demo)

## Our own products

- [CALVIQ](https://www.impacgo.com/calviq): dairy farm and cattle management software for cow farms: milk production tracking per animal, herd health and veterinary records, breeding, feed, QR ear tags, AI body condition scoring from smartphone photos, farm finance and KPI dashboards. For dairy farmers, cooperatives and multi-farm enterprises.
- [StockLyte](https://www.impacgo.com/stocklyte): inventory management software: real-time stock tracking across warehouses and stores, barcode scanning, reorder alerts, purchase orders, demand forecasting, works offline and syncs later.
- [FarmYieldIQ](https://www.impacgo.com/farmyieldiq): farmland plot management software for managed farmland projects: layouts, blocks and plots, pricing and registrations, partner portfolios with document vault and payments, plot sales pipeline.
- [HealthVault](https://www.impacgo.com/healthvault): family health records app: OCR-scanned prescriptions and reports per family member, AI health insights, vitals, reminders, emergency QR profile.
- [Work Task Application](https://www.impacgo.com/products/work-task): task and time tracking for consultants and field teams
- [Construction Planner](https://www.impacgo.com/products/construction-planner): construction project planning (in development)
